title: ZEHRA TERI DUA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
body:
ZEHRA TERI DUA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA ALLAH KI ATAA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
1. HAR HAAL MAY HUSSAIN KA MATAM KARENGE HUM BESHAK HUM ISS YAQEEN SE KARTEY HAIN SHAI KA GHAM HAR DARD KI DAWA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. TEENAT MAY HAI HAMARI GHAM E SHAI MILA HUWA MAABOOD KI YEH HUM PA KARAM KI HAI INTEHA QISMAT MAY LIKHDIYA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. AATI HAI MULKE SHAAM SE YE AAJ BHI SADA ZAALIM KOI BHI HOO NA IISAY ROOK PAYEGA ZAINAB KA MAREKA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
4. MATAM PE SHAHE DEEN KI JAAN APNI HAI NISAR FARSHE AZA PE ROONE KO RAHTE HAIN BEQARAR TASKEEN E FATIMA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
5. FARSHE AZA BICHAYENGE ROOKAR HUSSAIN KA DENGI DUAEIN FATIMA ZEHRA HAMAY SADA ARMAAN E FATIMA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
6. SHABBIR NE QUDA KE LIYE SAR KATADIYA GHAR BAAR KO WILAYATE HAQQ PAR LUTA DIYA EMAAN KI BAQA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
7. MATAM TOU HOGA AAP NA HAIRAT SE DEKHIYE
DUMB HO TOU AAKAY MAJLIS E SHABBIR ROKIYE MOMIN KA HOUSLA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
8. PARDA HATAAKE AAYEGA ZAIGHAM HUSSAIN KA KAABE PE PHIR LAGAYEGA PARCHAM HUSSAIN KA HAAN QWAHISH E QUDA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
9. HOGA GHAM E HUSSAIN HAMARI NISHIST MAY MAA ROYEGI HUSSAIN KI BAGH E BEHISHT MAY ZEHRA NE BHI KIYA HAI YEH MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
10. ZANJEER HUM LAGATE HAIN DARTE HAIN AAP KYUN KHOON APNA HIM BAHATE HAIN DARTE HAIN AAP KYUN CHAHAT KA MOJIIZA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
<<DIVIDER>>
11. KAISE LIKHEGA HASHMI NOUHA BATAA MUJHE ALFAAZ KEHRAHE HAIN KE NOUHA SUNA MUJHE AASHOOR KI SADA HAI YE MATAM HUSSAIN KA
AZZ:ALAMDAR HASHMI..
